name: Angel Match
description: Searchable database of ~124k–125k angel investors and VCs for founders raising seed. Freemium + paid subscription. US, founded 2019.

mentions.evidence: ~$24.8k MRR, 311 active subscriptions, ~$28.4k L30, ~$961k all-time, ~125,000 users claimed, founded Jan 2019, US. Last sync Oct 2, 2026.
mentions.indieAngle: Own a niche contact graph (angels, procurement buyers, clinic GMs) with enrichment + filters. Data freshness is the retention hook.

whyItPrints: Data directory SaaS — scrape/enrich once, charge annually for access. Nearly $1M all-time and ~$25k MRR with hundreds of subs; founders will keep paying while fundraising.
whyThisMatters:
Founders use Angel Match when they're looking for angels and venture capitalists. The database is more than 125,000 investors. You filter by location, industry, stage, and investor type. A profile can include an email, a phone number, LinkedIn, and other social accounts, plus past investments and the fund that person is tied to. Private equity investors are in the data too.

Search, build a list, export a CSV, or email from inside the product. You can track who you've contacted so the round doesn't live in a spreadsheet you stopped updating. Sign up and you can take a three-day trial. A one-month subscription is allowed if you only need the export once, and canceling leaves access in place until that month ends. They say the count grew from 700 investors in 2019 to where it is now, and that new names still get added. Andreessen Horowitz and Benchmark appear as examples of funds represented in the profiles.

It's a US company, started in 2019. You pay for access to the list and a simple way to work through it while you're raising.
